name: 22710-multiimage-qwen25vl7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine.
architecture: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, 8.29B params, ~16.6 GB bf16: a 28-layer decoder (hidden 3584, 28 query heads, 4 KV heads) behind a 32-block native-resolution ViT.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup 20%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 120 requests with an 1800 s safety cap; seed static 22710.
workload: single-turn multi-image chat synthesised by guidellm: ONE turn carrying eight distinct 1920x1080 gradient PNG images and a 32-token instruction, 8 output tokens pinned with ignore_eos, ~2.6 MB of base64 per request.
purpose: A vision assistant answering single-turn questions about eight full-HD images each, one request at a time, on one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM 0.10.0-612-gb159c0a67a on 1x H100 80GB HBM3.
# Keep the two inline-JSON values on ONE line each: re-flowed into a block mapping they are
# dropped silently, and without `max_pixels` eight 1080p images overrun max-model-len and
# every request is rejected on length.

model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 8}
mm-processor-kwargs: {"max_pixels": 200704}
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
